  chunk_output_type: console

STEP 4 of the pipeline (runs AFTER Temp.Rmd).

Purpose
-------
Download NHDPlus HR for HU4 0712 + 0713, snap every USGS Q / T site to a flowline
COMID, build one upstream basin per catchment, and keep only stream order >= 4.

Inputs
------
`data/shapes/illinois_river_basin.shp` (Boundaries.py) and
`daily_drivers_dir/q_t.parquet` (Temp.Rmd).

End-state of this file
----------------------
`flowlines.gpkg` and `catchments.gpkg` (stream order >= 4), `site_upstream_basins.gpkg`,
`sites_with_comid.csv`, and **`q_t_comid.parquet`** (Q + T with COMID and stream order).
Consumed by Meteo.Rmd.

Comment style (inside every chunk): `## N.` section, `###` step, `####` note,
`#` inline bit. Same convention as every other script in SRC/.

```{r setup}
## 1. Setup
### Load shared paths, packages and helper functions
source("SRC/Functions_Paths.R")

### Packages used in this step (data.table speeds up the upstream routing lookup)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
library(dataRetrieval)
library(nhdplusTools)
library(data.table)

### Use planar geometry (s2 off) for the intersections below
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)
```

```{r aoi}
## 2. Load the AOI
### Read the Boundaries.py basin shapefile, make it valid
aoi <- st_read(basin_shp, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  st_make_valid()
```

```{r nhd-hr-download}
## 3. Download NHDPlus HR
### Illinois basin = HU4 0712 + 0713
hu4s        <- c("0712", "0713")
hr_data_dir <- file.path(nhd_dir, "hr_raw")
hr_gpkg     <- file.path(nhd_dir, "nhdplushr.gpkg")

dir.create(hr_data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

### Download the raw HR geodatabases
download_nhdplushr(hr_data_dir, hu4s)

### Read the flowline + catchment layers and cache them in one gpkg
hr <- get_nhdplushr(
  hr_data_dir,
  layers   = c("NHDFlowline", "NHDPlusCatchment"),
  out_gpkg = hr_gpkg
)
```

```{r flowlines-catchments}
## 4. Flowlines and catchments
### HR flowlines clipped to the AOI
#### Columns are renamed to lowercase to match the rest of the pipeline
flowlines <- hr$NHDFlowline %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  rename(
    comid      = COMID,
    reachcode  = REACHCODE,
    gnis_name  = GNIS_Name,
    lengthkm   = LENGTHKM,
    areasqkm   = TotDASqKM,
    slope      = Slope,
    streamorde = StreamOrde,
    streamcalc = StreamCalc,
    hydroseq   = Hydroseq,
    levelpathi = LevelPathI,
    fromnode   = FromNode,
    tonode     = ToNode,
    terminalfl = TerminalFl,
    startflag  = StartFlag,
    divergence = Divergence
  ) %>%
  select(comid, reachcode, gnis_name, lengthkm, areasqkm, slope,
         streamorde, streamcalc, hydroseq, levelpathi,
         fromnode, tonode, terminalfl, startflag, divergence) %>%
  st_intersection(aoi)

### HR catchments clipped to the AOI (comid = FEATUREID)
catchments <- hr$NHDPlusCatchment %>%
  st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "geom") %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(FEATUREID)) %>%
  rename(areasqkm = AreaSqKM) %>%
  select(comid, areasqkm) %>%
  st_intersection(aoi)
```

```{r orphan-check}
## 5. Orphan check
### Flag flowlines missing a from / to node (not routable)
orphans <- flowlines %>%
  filter(is.na(fromnode) | is.na(tonode)) %>%
  pull(comid)

if (length(orphans) > 0) {
  warning("Orphan COMIDs found: ", paste(orphans, collapse = ", "))
} else {
  message("All COMIDs routable (no orphan edges).")
}
```


```{r load and snap-sites-to-comid}

## 6. Load Q+T and site coordinates
### Load Q+T from Temp.Rmd
q_t <- read_parquet(file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "q_t.parquet")) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

site_ids <- paste0("USGS-", unique(q_t$site_no))

### Batch into groups of 50
batch_size <- 50
batches <- split(site_ids, ceiling(seq_along(site_ids) / batch_size))

site_info_raw <- purrr::map(batches, function(batch) {
  Sys.sleep(0.5)
  result <- read_waterdata_monitoring_location(
    monitoring_location_id = batch,
    skipGeometry           = FALSE
  )

  coords <- st_coordinates(result)

  result %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    mutate(
      across(everything(), as.character),
      longitude = coords[, 1],
      latitude  = coords[, 2]
    )
})

### Build sf points from the monitoring-location coordinates
#### Sites are not clipped to the AOI here; sites that do not snap to an AOI flowline drop out in section 7
site_coords_all <- bind_rows(site_info_raw) %>%
  filter(!is.na(longitude), !is.na(latitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(site_no = gsub("^USGS-", "", monitoring_location_id))
```

```{r snap-sites-to-comid}
## 7. Snap sites to COMID
### Primary snap: nearest flowline with VAA measures
#### Uses the full network so small tributaries don't get misrouted to a mainstem reach
#### NOTE: site_coords is used below but never defined in this file; define it first (e.g. site_coords <- site_coords_all)
vaa <- get_vaa() %>% select(comid, frommeas, tomeas)

flowlines_idx <- flowlines %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) %>%
  left_join(vaa, by = "comid") %>%
  rename(
    FromMeas = frommeas,
    ToMeas   = tomeas
  )

### Snap sites to flowlines (50 m search radius)
site_matches <- get_flowline_index(
  flowlines_idx,
  site_coords,
  search_radius = 50
)

sites_with_comid_sf <- site_coords %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(site_matches$COMID)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(comid))

### Compute snap distance from each site to its assigned flowline
flow_match <- flowlines %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid))

matched_lines <- flow_match[match(sites_with_comid_sf$comid, flow_match$comid), ]

snap_dist_m <- st_distance(
  st_transform(sites_with_comid_sf, 5070),
  st_transform(matched_lines, 5070),
  by_element = TRUE
)

sites_with_comid_sf <- sites_with_comid_sf %>%
  mutate(snap_dist_m = as.numeric(snap_dist_m))

cat("\nSnap distance summary (meters):\n")
print(summary(sites_with_comid_sf$snap_dist_m))

### Keep only defensible direct matches
#### Sites farther than snap_dist_threshold_m (250 m) from their assigned flowline are dropped
snap_dist_threshold_m <- 250

sites_with_comid_sf <- sites_with_comid_sf %>%
  filter(snap_dist_m <= snap_dist_threshold_m)

cat("Sites retained after snap-distance filter:", nrow(sites_with_comid_sf), "\n")

### Optional: inspect excluded sites
sites_excluded_bad_snap <- site_coords %>%
  left_join(
    sites_with_comid_sf %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(site_no, comid, snap_dist_m),
    by = "site_no"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.na(comid))

cat("Sites excluded for missing/poor COMID match:", nrow(sites_excluded_bad_snap), "\n")

### Final site_no -> comid lookup used downstream
sites_with_comid <- sites_with_comid_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(site_no, comid)

### Save the lookup to data/shapes/sites_with_comid.csv
write.csv(
  sites_with_comid,
  file.path(shape_dir, "sites_with_comid.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r build-upstream-basins, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}

## 8. Build upstream basins locally
### Read the slim flowline routing table and the catchments
#### NOTE: flowlines.gpkg / catchments.gpkg are read from disk here but (re)written in section 13, so they must exist from an earlier pass
flowlines <- st_read(flowlines_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    comid = as.character(comid),
    fromnode = as.character(fromnode),
    tonode = as.character(tonode)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(comid), !is.na(fromnode), !is.na(tonode))

catchments <- st_read(catchment_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(comid))

cat("Flowline COMIDs:", n_distinct(flowlines$comid), "\n")
cat("Catchment COMIDs:", n_distinct(catchments$comid), "\n")

### Target COMIDs: one upstream basin per catchment COMID
#### For testing, uncomment slice_head(n = 100) below, then remove it for the full run

target_comids <- catchments %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  distinct(comid)

# TEST MODE:
# target_comids <- target_comids %>% slice_head(n = 100)

cat("Target COMIDs to delineate:", nrow(target_comids), "\n")

### Build the upstream routing lookup
#### In the routed network: upstream reach tonode == downstream reach fromnode
#### So the immediate upstream reaches of a target COMID are those where upstream.tonode == target.fromnode

flow_dt <- as.data.table(flowlines)

reach_nodes <- flow_dt[, .(comid, fromnode, tonode)]

# For each node, which COMIDs flow into that node?
upstream_by_node <- split(reach_nodes$comid, reach_nodes$tonode)

# For each COMID, what is its upstream node?
fromnode_by_comid <- setNames(reach_nodes$fromnode, reach_nodes$comid)

### Breadth-first walk upstream: returns the COMID plus every COMID upstream of it
get_upstream_comids <- function(target_comid) {
  target_comid <- as.character(target_comid)

  if (!target_comid %in% names(fromnode_by_comid)) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  visited <- character(0)
  queue <- target_comid

  while (length(queue) > 0) {
    current <- queue[1]
    queue <- queue[-1]

    if (current %in% visited) next

    visited <- c(visited, current)

    current_fromnode <- fromnode_by_comid[[current]]
    ups <- upstream_by_node[[current_fromnode]]

    if (!is.null(ups)) {
      ups <- as.character(ups)
      ups <- setdiff(ups, visited)
      queue <- unique(c(queue, ups))
    }
  }

  visited
}

### Build one basin polygon per target COMID
#### Each basin is the union of the catchment itself and all catchments upstream of it

basin_list <- vector("list", nrow(target_comids))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(target_comids))) {
  cid <- target_comids$comid[i]

  message(
    "Building local upstream basin for COMID ",
    i, " of ", nrow(target_comids), ": ", cid
  )

  ups <- get_upstream_comids(cid)

  if (!length(ups)) {
    basin_list[[i]] <- NULL
    next
  }

  basin_i <- catchments %>%
    filter(comid %in% ups)

  if (nrow(basin_i) == 0) {
    basin_list[[i]] <- NULL
    next
  }

  # Use st_geometry() instead of assuming the geometry column is named "geometry".
  basin_union <- st_sf(
    comid = cid,
    n_upstream_catchments = nrow(basin_i),
    geometry = st_sfc(
      st_union(st_geometry(basin_i)),
      crs = st_crs(basin_i)
    )
  )

  basin_list[[i]] <- basin_union
}

basins <- compact(basin_list) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  st_as_sf()

if (nrow(basins) == 0) {
  stop("No local upstream basins were created.")
}

### Write output to site_upstream_basins.gpkg

write_gpkg_overwrite(basins, basins_path)

cat("Wrote local upstream basins to:", basins_path, "\n")
cat("Basin COMIDs written:", n_distinct(basins$comid), "\n")
cat("Total basin rows:", nrow(basins), "\n")

### Diagnostics: how many upstream catchments per basin

basins %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(
    n_basins = n(),
    n_comids = n_distinct(comid),
    min_upstream_catchments = min(n_upstream_catchments, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_upstream_catchments = median(n_upstream_catchments, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_upstream_catchments = max(n_upstream_catchments, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
## 9. Sanity check: basins vs catchments
### Every catchment COMID should have an upstream basin

catchments <- st_read(catchment_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) %>%
  distinct(comid)

basins <- st_read(basins_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) %>%
  distinct(comid)

missing_basin_comids <- anti_join(catchments, basins, by = "comid")

missing_basin_comids %>%
  summarise(n_missing = n()) %>%
  print()

head(missing_basin_comids, 20)
```

```{r}
## 10. Sanity check: flowlines vs catchments
### Count COMIDs in each table and list flowlines without catchments
catchments %>% summarise(n_catchment_comids = n_distinct(comid))

flowlines <- st_read(flowlines_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) %>%
  distinct(comid)

flowlines %>% summarise(n_flowline_comids = n_distinct(comid))

anti_join(flowlines, catchments, by = "comid") %>%
  summarise(flowline_comids_without_catchments = n())
```


```{r join-and-filter-so4}
## 11. Attach stream order and filter to >= 4
### Attach stream order onto Q+T via COMID, then filter Q+T and hydro layers
#### Everything is cut to stream order >= 4 in one consistent pass
flow_attrs <- flowlines %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) %>%
  select(comid, streamorde)

q_t_comid <- q_t %>%
  left_join(sites_with_comid, by = "site_no") %>%
  filter(!is.na(comid)) %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) %>%
  left_join(flow_attrs, by = "comid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(streamorde), streamorde >= 4)%>%
  group_by(site_no) %>%
  filter(any(!is.na(q_m3s) | !is.na(water_temp_C))) %>%
  ungroup()

### Unique Q and T sensors by stream order (after SO >= 4 filter)
sensor_counts_by_order <- q_t_comid %>%
  group_by(streamorde) %>%
  summarise(
    n_q_sensors = n_distinct(site_no[!is.na(q_m3s)]),
    n_t_sensors = n_distinct(site_no[!is.na(water_temp_C)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(streamorde)

cat("\nUnique sensors by stream order:\n")
print(sensor_counts_by_order)

### Apply the same stream-order filter to flowlines and catchments
flowlines <- flowlines %>% filter(!is.na(streamorde), streamorde >= 4)

keep_comids <- unique(as.character(flowlines$comid))
catchments  <- catchments %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) %>%
  filter(comid %in% keep_comids)
```

```{r}
## 12. Sensor counts by stream order
### Stream order breakdown of unique Q and T sensors
q_sensor_counts <- q_t_comid %>%
  filter(!is.na(streamorde), !is.na(q_m3s)) %>%
  distinct(streamorde, site_no) %>%
  count(streamorde, name = "n_q_sensors") %>%
  arrange(streamorde)

t_sensor_counts <- q_t_comid %>%
  filter(!is.na(streamorde), !is.na(water_temp_C)) %>%
  distinct(streamorde, site_no) %>%
  count(streamorde, name = "n_t_sensors") %>%
  arrange(streamorde)

sensor_counts_by_order <- full_join(q_sensor_counts, t_sensor_counts, by = "streamorde") %>%
  arrange(streamorde)

cat("\nUnique sensors by stream order:\n")
print(sensor_counts_by_order)
```


```{r write-final-outputs}
## 13. Write final outputs
### Output paths
flowline_out  <- file.path(nhd_dir, "flowlines.gpkg")
catchment_out <- file.path(nhd_dir, "catchments.gpkg")
q_t_comid_out <- file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "q_t_comid.parquet")

### Remove old outputs so nothing is appended
for (f in c(flowline_out, catchment_out, q_t_comid_out)) {
  if (file.exists(f)) file.remove(f)
}

### Write flowlines, catchments (stream order >= 4) and Q+T+COMID
st_write(flowlines,  flowline_out,  quiet = TRUE)
st_write(catchments, catchment_out, quiet = TRUE)
write_parquet(q_t_comid, q_t_comid_out)

### Final summary
cat("\nFinal Q+T+COMID (stream order >= 4):\n")
print(q_t_comid %>% summarise(
  n_rows          = n(),
  n_sites         = n_distinct(site_no),
  n_comids        = n_distinct(comid),
  min_date        = min(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_date        = max(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
  pct_rows_with_Q = mean(!is.na(q_m3s)),
  pct_rows_with_T = mean(!is.na(water_temp_C))
))
```

The following is to assess why there are so many stream order 1 sites

```{r}
## 14. Diagnostic: why so many stream order 1 sites
### One row per site with assigned COMID + stream order
site_stream_order <- q_t %>%
  distinct(site_no) %>%
  left_join(sites_with_comid, by = "site_no") %>%
  filter(!is.na(comid)) %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid)) %>%
  left_join(flow_attrs, by = "comid") %>%
  distinct(site_no, comid, streamorde)

### Quick diagnostic table
site_stream_order %>%
  count(streamorde, name = "n_sites") %>%
  arrange(streamorde) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
## 15. Site map
### Rebuild an sf version of sites with stream order attached
#### Map is zoomed to the AOI: flowlines in grey, sites in red
site_points_map <- site_coords %>%
  left_join(site_stream_order, by = "site_no")

aoi_bbox <- st_bbox(aoi)

par(mar = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")

plot(
  st_geometry(aoi),
  col = "grey95",
  border = "black",
  xlim = c(aoi_bbox["xmin"], aoi_bbox["xmax"]),
  ylim = c(aoi_bbox["ymin"], aoi_bbox["ymax"]),
  asp  = 1
)

plot(
  st_geometry(flowlines),
  col = "grey70",
  lwd = 0.4,
  add = TRUE
)

plot(
  st_geometry(site_points_map),
  col = "red",
  pch = 16,
  cex = 0.35,
  add = TRUE
)
```
